name: Impossible Range Synergy (Item Mastery)
body:
Distance matters little when you take aim.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Weapon Focus with a ranged weapon.

Benefit(s): When attacking with a magic ranged weapon while you are wearing an eye slot magic item, the weapon gains the effects of the longshot spell.
